# Men Who Feel

> Anonymous, free mental wellbeing platform for men, organized around four pillars: Mental & Emotional Health, Work & Financial Stability, Relationships & Stress, and Physical Wellbeing. No account required for most of the site.

## Core sections

- [Intel](https://www.menwhofeel.online/intel): Articles answering "what should I know" — practical, research-grounded explainers across all four pillars.
- [Toolkit](https://www.menwhofeel.online/guides): Curated tools and resources answering "what can I use."
- [Challenges](https://www.menwhofeel.online/challenges): Structured, day-by-day journeys (Career Reset, Relationship Reset, Physical Reset) answering "what should I do today."
- [Community](https://www.menwhofeel.online/community): Anonymous peer discussion, answering "who understands me."
- [Career Hub](https://www.menwhofeel.online/career-hub): Job search and career-transition resources, answering "how do I move forward."
- [Small Wins](https://www.menwhofeel.online/small-wins): Ways to earn or make immediate financial progress, answering "how do I earn now."
- [Check-In](https://www.menwhofeel.online/assessment): A short self-assessment across the four pillars, with a personalized starting point.
- [Provider Directory](https://www.menwhofeel.online/provider-directory): Vetted therapists, doctors, and recovery resources — every listing reviewed by a person before it goes live, not scraped.
- [Crisis Helpline](https://www.menwhofeel.online/crisis-helpline): Free crisis resources for anyone in immediate distress.

## Optional

- [Founder's Story](https://www.menwhofeel.online/founders-story): Why the platform exists.
- [About](https://www.menwhofeel.online/about): Platform overview.
- [Stories](https://www.menwhofeel.online/stories): First-person accounts from users.
